steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The UK is a permanent member of the UN Security Council with veto power, giving it significant influence over international responses to conflicts and crises. | Key Fact: The UK is a member of NATO (military alliance), the G7 (major economies), the Commonwealth (56 nations), and the Council of Europe (human rights). | Key Fact: Globalisation means decisions made in one country affect others — economic crises, climate change, pandemics, and migration all cross borders. No nation can solve these alone. | Key Fact: The UK government's foreign policy is decided by the Prime Minister and Foreign Secretary, with limited parliamentary control. However, Parliament must approve military action.
